design.name: Plug Classic — 은빛 휴대용 플레이어
design.font_family: Segoe UI Variable Text, Segoe UI, sans-serif
design.korean_font: Malgun Gothic (맑은 고딕); Hangul fallback after Segoe UI. Numerals and time on the LCD: Cascadia Mono, then Consolas.
design.rationale: The reference image is a Nexon Plug-style messenger: a silver chrome shell with a circular avatar on the left, a recessed blue LCD strip in the middle, and a round control pad with an orange play button on the right. A list below it has tabs and grouped sections. This design keeps that layout but drops the late-2000s gloss. It uses a flat brushed-metal surface with a single 1px highlight and a single 1px shadow. Each theme has one accent color, used only for play, progress, and selection. Korean text is the priority: Malgun Gothic at 12px or larger, no negative letter-spacing on Hangul, at least 1.35 line height, and tabular digits so time and track counts don't jitter. In the collapsed state the player shows only artwork, the current track, and the control pad, at a mini-player density. Expanding it adds a list area that copies the reference's grouped-section layout (재생 중 / 대기열 / 보관함), with 32px rows that keep Hangul readable without crowding. All fonts ship with Windows 10 and 11, and no font files are bundled.

collapsed.size: 480x190 (minimum 440x176, maximum 640x220; the height grows only to fit text scaling)

zones.artwork: Left. 132px circle, vertically centered, x=14. 2px ring in the border color, plus an inner 1px highlight at 18% white for a bezel look. A 4px progress ring in the accent color is drawn just outside the art, starting at 12 o'clock.
zones.lcd: Center, about 200x96. Recessed panel with radius 8: a 1px inner shadow at the top and a 1px highlight at the bottom. Line 1: track title, 14px semibold, one line, marquee only on hover after 1.5s. Line 2: artist · album, 12px, muted. Line 3: time 0:00 / 0:00, Cascadia Mono 12px, plus a format badge (FLAC/MP3) at 10px uppercase Latin. A 3px seek bar with an 8px handle on the bottom edge; the hit area is 14px tall.
zones.control_pad: Right. 112px circle, like the reference's d-pad. The center play/pause button is 52px with an accent fill, a 1px darker rim, and a subtle radial gradient (top +6% lightness). Previous and next sit at 9 and 3 o'clock; volume and shuffle/repeat at 12 and 6. Each is a 28px hit target with an 18px icon.
zones.title_strip: Top-right corner, 22px tall, inside the frame. Buttons: 항상 위 (pin), 설정, 최소화, 닫기. 16px icons on 22px targets with 4px gaps. Doubles as the drag region.
zones.expand_handle: Bottom center. 40x6 rounded grip with a ▾ caret, plus a full-width 8px hover zone. Click or drag to expand.

expanded.added_height: 320–440px, default 380, resized by dragging the bottom edge
expanded.total_size: 480x510 to 480x630 at default width; width follows the collapsed shell

structure.divider: 1px border line with a 1px highlight underneath (groove), sitting 8px below the collapsed shell
structure.tabs: 36px tall segmented row: 보관함 · 대기열 · 재생목록 · 영상. 13px semibold Korean label with an optional 9px Latin sub-label (LIBRARY/QUEUE/PLAYLIST/VIDEO) at 60% opacity, echoing the reference's 친구/FRIENDS tabs. The active tab is the panel color with a 2px accent underline.
structure.search_bar: 32px tall, radius 6, 12px Korean placeholder '검색 (곡, 아티스트, 앨범)'
structure.list: Grouped sections with collapsible headers, e.g. '▾ 지금 재생 중 (1)', '▾ 다음 곡 (12)', '▾ 최근 추가 (65)'. Headers are 26px, 12px semibold, in the muted color, with a 1px accent-tinted line below. Rows are 32px: 24px circular thumbnail, title 13px, artist 11.5px muted on the same line separated by ' · ', duration right-aligned in tabular mono 12px. The playing row gets a 3px left accent bar and a 10% accent tint. Thin 6px overlay scrollbar.
structure.video_tab: 16:9 surface fills the width minus 16px padding. Controls overlay at the bottom with a 28px gradient scrim. The collapsed shell keeps acting as the transport.
structure.bottom_toolbar: 36px tall with icon buttons at 28px targets: left 폴더 추가, 재생목록 만들기; right 정렬, 보기 전환. Copies the reference's footer button pair.

layout.resize: Corner and edge grips at 6px. Collapsed height is locked unless the user's text scale goes above 100%. Width changes reflow the LCD zone only; the artwork and the pad keep fixed sizes.
layout.dpi: Design values are logical px at 100%. Use Qt high-DPI scaling with the PassThrough rounding policy, and render the circular art with QPainterPath clipping plus antialiasing.

refinements: Korean typography: Malgun Gothic, never below 11.5px for Hangul body text (12px preferred) and 13px for list titles. Letter-spacing 0 for Hangul; +0.5px only for uppercase Latin micro-labels. Never use synthetic italics on Korean.
Font stack in QSS: font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text', 'Segoe UI', 'Malgun Gothic'. Set QFont.setFamilies so Hangul glyphs fall back to Malgun Gothic and don't drop into Gulim.
Use tabular figures for all time, count, and index text (Cascadia Mono, then Consolas) so the LCD doesn't shift as seconds tick.

Contrast: text on panel is at least 12:1 in every theme, and muted on panel at least 4.8:1. The glyph on the play button uses the theme's text color in silver_blue and warm_cream (dark glyph on orange/rust) and #0B0F14 in midnight and visualizer, keeping it at 4.5:1 or better.

Surface texture: one tiled 64x64 noise PNG at 2–3% opacity over bg. silver_blue additionally gets a horizontal brushed-metal stripe at 3%. Textures are never applied behind text inside the LCD or list.

User background image: drawn under bg with a theme-colored scrim. The scrim stays at least 72% opaque behind the LCD and list, whatever the user's opacity setting, so text contrast holds. The image is blurred 24px in the expanded area.

User accent color: derive hover (+8% lightness), pressed (−10%), selection tint (10% alpha), and progress from the one value. Automatically pick a dark or light play glyph using the WCAG relative-luminance threshold.
Window opacity: 60–100% applies to the whole window. Below 85%, show a 1px border in the border color at full opacity so the window edges stay readable.
Always on top: a pin icon in the title strip. Active state is accent-filled, and the tooltip reads '항상 위에 표시'.
Control pad tactility: a press state that moves the inner gradient down 1px and darkens the rim. No scale or bounce animation.

Motion budget: expand/collapse takes 180ms with OutCubic easing on height only; hover fades take 90ms. The visualizer theme alone gets a 24-bar spectrum behind the LCD at 35% accent opacity, capped at 30fps and paused while the window is minimized or occluded.
Album art without a cover: a muted-color circle with the first Hangul or Latin character of the artist in 40px semibold. Never leave a blank gray circle.
Focus states: a 2px accent focus ring offset 2px on all controls. Tab order goes play → previous → next → volume → seek → tabs → list.
Korean UI strings stay short to fit the density: 재생, 일시정지, 이전 곡, 다음 곡, 반복, 셔플, 음량, 대기열에 추가, 재생목록에 저장.
Icons: Segoe Fluent Icons on Windows 11, with Segoe MDL2 Assets as the fallback on Windows 10. Both are system fonts, so no icon assets need to ship.
